name: QiYi Bubble 3x3
description: The QiYi Bubble 3x3 trades flat faces for rounded, ball-shaped pieces that look like a cube built out of bubbles. It solves like a 3x3 puzzle with a playful shape and bright bubble-inspired colors, designed for younger cubers and anyone who wants something that stands out on the desk.
features: Fresh, bright colors: The stickerless color scheme is energetic and cheerful, built to catch the eye and keep solving fun.
Great for new cubers: The chunky, grippable balls are easy for smaller hands to hold and turn, making it a friendly first puzzle.
Conversation starter: It doesn't look like any cube on the shelf, which makes it as much a display piece as a puzzle.
Rounded ball pieces: The signature bubble shape gives the puzzle a distinctive feel in the hand and a soft profile from every angle.
Stickerless build: Colors run through the plastic, so there are no stickers to peel or wear down over time.
Standard 3x3 mechanism: Under the bubble shell it solves like a normal 3x3, so the moves and methods you already know still apply.
